senses.definition: n.pr.m. (so on an Isr. scarab, GanneauJAS 1883, 156, No. 42)—
an Ephraimite, Ju 17:1, 4 (in 17:5 ff.; 18:2 ff. called מִיכָה).
a prophet, the son of Imlah (𝔊 Μειχαίας), 1 K 22:8–26 (9 times), ‖ 2 Ch 18:7–25 (7 times) + v 8 Qr (Kt מיכהו).
a contemp. of Jer., Je 36:11 (מִכָֽיְהוּ), v 13.
